source: vqsv5.jar data/data.d (ak.j()), formulas from class al and class ak

confidence.direct: Stat formulas, type ids, ranks, skill unlock slots, SP costs and the damage/hit formulas are read from bytecode.
confidence.unresolved: Pet columns 13-14 and the byte tables ak.e/ak.v are exported raw or ignored; the special skills 26-48 and statuses are read from ak.c(), ak.b() and the end-of-round code (see special and status_rules). Column 12 is the initial evolution counter.

rules.stats: hp = c0 + c7*L/10; sp = c1 + c8*L/10; agility = c2 + c9*L/10; attack = c3 + c10*L/10; defense = c4 + c11*L/10

evolution_rules.counter: per-pet counter starts at c12 of the species, -1 per evolution, 0 after a mutation; evolving needs counter > 0
evolution_rules.consumes: all listed materials; a mutation also consumes one mutation item (id 34) and replaces the normal evolution
evolution_rules.on_success: level kept, target species stats recomputed with the same formulas, full HP and SP

checks: mutation targets == pets found by mutation (ak.o 253)
initial counter == evolution chain length for every base form

trait_rules.wild_mode: random; lucky when the lead pet knows skill 39 (Hạnh Vận Chi Tinh)

chest_rules.evidence: ak.c() items 32/33; the victory code rolls rand(100) < 50 for item 32; box.d is read as pairs [item, cumulative %]
other_sources: field chests (gold x100, medals or one item)

status_rules.single_status: a combatant can carry one status; a new one only lands while none is active (ak.b(z,al,al,int): al3.b != 7 -> no)
